Got questions?

Quick answers

Kya perfumes original aur long-lasting hain?

Ji haan. Har bottle 100% authentic hai aur Eau de Parfum concentration ki wajah se 8-10 ghante tak chalti hai.

Delivery mein kitna time lagta hai?

Major cities mein 2-3 din, baaqi Pakistan mein 3-5 din. Rs 5,000 se upar order par delivery free hai.

Cash on delivery available hai?

Bilkul. Aap parcel dekh kar payment kar sakte hain.

Agar pasand na aaye to?

7 din ke andar easy return/exchange. Bas humein WhatsApp karein.

How to use

Spray 2-3 times on pulse points — neck, wrists and behind the ears — from 15 cm away. Do not rub. For longer wear, apply on moisturised skin.

Shipping & returns

Free delivery on orders above Rs 5,000. Standard delivery 2-4 working days. Cash on delivery available. Easy 7-day return or exchange on unopened items.

Drift · Rs 2,490

Our story

Born from the sea breeze.

Drift was imagined on a late-night drive along the Karachi coast — salt in the air, citrus on the breeze, the city lights fading behind.
We wanted a fragrance that moves with you: fresh at first, calm at heart, and quietly confident long after you've left the room.
Every bottle is blended in small batches and finished in deep sapphire glass with gold detailing.

A fragrance should feel like a memory you haven't made yet.
